title: Check list items.
summary: When constructing a list using [item, ...], mypy checks that each item is compatible with the list type that is inferred from the surrounding context. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check that literal is used where expected.
summary: There are some places where only a (string) literal value is expected for the purposes of static type checking, for example a TypedDict key, or a __match_args__ item. Providing a str-valued variable in such contexts will result in an error. mypy enables this error code by default.
